request_flow: User enters through pmp-app-current.html stable door.
Stable door loads pmp-current-map-v9.json or pmp-current-map.json fallback.
Map chooses Route Guardian loader; v9 map points to pmp-route-guardian-current-loader-v14.html.
Route Guardian v14 waits for manual Open Latest App, then loads pmp-current-inner-cleanbug-rgcontrols-v4.html and injects support scripts.
v3 wrapper loads pmp-home-single-v6.html and support scripts including Resident X-Ray, lossless readiness, work fix, truth face, and other private-window adapters.
User opens Resident drawer in base app, types in textarea#ask, and taps Run.
Injected wrappers may intercept residentRun before original local Resident logic: X-Ray refresh, lossless readiness check, work-copy fix, and top-shell copy/open helpers.
If intercepted command matches, wrapper writes a local report/reply and may arm/copy/open Shortcut. If not intercepted, original residentRun applies local regex branches.
Original residentRun reads ask/paste/localStorage/sessionStorage, selects a fixed local command branch, and builds either local reply/action, local storage update, or manual ChatGPT handoff.
reply_flow: Original Resident replies through plain(), residentReply, residentWarning, residentWork, session chat, and pmp_single_resident_work_v6 ledger.
X-Ray wrapper writes pmp_resident_xray_context_v1, pmp_resident_xray_rule_v1, and pmp_resident_xray_history_v1 before answer.
Lossless readiness wrapper writes residentReply/residentWork and pmp_resident_lossless_readiness_latest_v1 for matching readiness/copy-lossless questions.
Work-copy fix replaces showWork/copyWork so visible work or diagnostic JSON is copied.
Top-shell lossless copy/open builds a vault write packet from local Inventory Eyes reports, copies it, and opens the PMP Vault GitHub Writer Shortcut.
Tool-specific Resident pages/docks write local JSON/template responses to their visible output blocks.
